_note: Dataset endpoints (upload/validate/standardize) had no frozen contract file until now — added retroactively during M3 Stage 5, based on real verified Swagger output, not the original playbook's Section 14 examples (which never covered Dataset). TEAM COORDINATION REQUIRED if this shape changes.

upload_response._status_enum_note: status is always 'uploaded' on this response — later stages (validate/standardize) transition it further, see below

upload_query_param.dataset_type: required, one of _dataset_type_enum above, passed as a query string param (not in the multipart body)

standardize_response_unmapped_fields_exa._note: unmapped_fields is a list of per-feature objects when some raw fields could not be fuzzy-matched, empty list when everything mapped cleanly

standardize_unsupported_dataset_type_res.detail: No field-mapping dictionary yet for dataset_type 'municipal'
standardize_unsupported_dataset_type_res._note: Fires when dataset_type has no entry in DATASET_TYPE_SYNONYMS yet (currently only 'cadastral' is implemented; 'municipal' and 'building' are not). Fixed in M3 Stage 5 — previously this case silently returned a fake 200 with features_created/unmapped_fields both null.
